about: The colour a Number Format's section names, answered with the text it shows (ADR-0071, SH-40, ADR-0016, ADR-0047): by the section a number or a text used, at a width or not, and none where no section was used. Transcribed from ExSheet.Engine.Tests' NumberFormatColourTests; the legacy palette's values are in the surface tests.
